name: document-extraction
description: Runs the API and the frontend together.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix api run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix api exec tsc -- --noEmit && npm --prefix frontend exec tsc -- -b --noEmit
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix frontend install
